summary: Allen Ginsborg, 59, of Loveland reported missing after his family found his pickup truck at Lon Hagler Reservoir southwest of Loveland; multi-agency search Jul 6-8; body found dead Jul 10 ~1.5 mi east of the reservoir
location: Lon Hagler Reservoir, southwest of Loveland
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Search and Rescue; UCHealth Lifeline helicopter; Loveland Fire Rescue Authority; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Larimer County Dive Rescue Team; Search and Rescue Dogs of the US
notes: Search agencies worked Jul 6-8 without locating him; body recovered Jul 10; cause of death not released at publication. 2026-09-20: merged LCSAR FB post permalink (LCSAR 2020-07-08 post on its ongoing search operations near Lon Hagler Reservoir; full-str).
